test_cases.name: Export Markdown report (default format)
test_cases.expected: Prints generated .md path; report has headers 名称/ID/引擎/版本/容量/规格/状态/连接地址/端口/可用区 + data rows + summary line

test_cases.name: Aligned table output
test_cases.expected: Aligned full-field table with name/instance_id/engine/status/ip/port/az columns

test_cases.name: Instance list as JSON
test_cases.expected: JSON array of complete DCS instance objects

test_cases.name: Empty result produces no file
test_cases.expected: No DCS instances → friendly message, exit 0, no .md created

notes: 只读操作（ListInstances），无资源创建/修改/删除风险；Markdown 仅在本机生成，绝不写回云端。CLI 主路径使用 hcloud DCS ListInstances（经 skill-quality-cli 包裹）；SDK 回退使用 huaweicloudsdkdcs v2；SDK 缺失时运行 scripts/ensure_env.py 自动安装。
